messages:
ashley: Received updated capacity CSV from VertexCloud — they included time-of-day availability curves and a new 'soft-reserve' bucket. attaching sample. Need inputs for cost model: how do we incorporate daypart spot volatility? :thinking_face:

mike: Can you paste the CSV headers? We need to map to our cost model columns (sku, region, commit_tier, reserved_hours_per_week, spot_floor_usd, eviction_prob_hourly)

ashley: sure, sample below:
```
sku,region,commit_tier,reserved_hours_per_week,spot_floor_usd,eviction_prob_hourly,soft_reserve_pct,daypart_curve_json
vtx-gpu-a,us-west-2,standard,168,0.10,0.002,0.12,{"00-06":0.5,"06-12":0.7,"12-18":0.9,"18-24":0.6}
```

sophia: Important: the 'soft_reserve_pct' means capacity they keep for burst customers with 6h notice? Vendor contract says 6h soft-hold window but no SLA. We should treat that as probabilistic availability at 50% of advertised daypart curve.

devon: For model: I'd run two sims — base (assume vetoed soft_reserve as unavailable) and optimistic (50% of soft_reserve usable). Also need a GPU-substitution penalty when vtx-gpu-a not available and we fall back to vtx-gpu-b (higher cost, +15% latency)

mike: Agreed. Also need termination penalties: do they bill for early release of reserved hours? vendor-team?

vendor-team: quick clar: no early termination fee for soft-reserve swaps, but reserved commitments have a 3-month minimum and a 10% pro-rated early-exit fee. Spot floor is guaranteed minimum price per-hour we won't go below; eviction_prob_hourly provided is empirical from last 90 days.

ashley: OK, for pricing inputs we need: effective cost per token estimate, two availability curves (pessimistic/optimistic), eviction shock scenarios (1%, 5%, 20% sudden spike), and substitution matrix with cost and latency multipliers.

devon: I'll add substitution matrix stub:
```
from,to,cost_mult,latency_ms_mult
vtx-gpu-a,vtx-gpu-b,1.15,1.25
vtx-gpu-a,epc-gpu-c,1.45,1.60
```

sophia: Also track region affinity. If primary region unavailable, cross-region egress can add $0.02/token in worst case (estimate). Mark as sensitivity.

mike: Who owns adding daypart-aware batching suggestions in Optimize? product/ops?

ashley: tagging @sophia for ops, @devon for model sims, @mike for finance inputs. supply-bot uploaded CSV to /shared/partnerships/vertexcloud_q2_supply.csv :link:

 supply-bot: file uploaded by vendor-team at 2968534215 - /shared/partnerships/vertexcloud_q2_supply.csv :white_check_mark:

vendor-team: FYI we'll push weekly deltas on Fridays. If you want raw telemetry instead of aggregated curves, we can provide S3 access next week.

ashley: Great — we'll do a weekly ingest. Plan: devon run Monte Carlo with 10k sims using these three shock levels, mike to convert outputs into a per-token unit cost delta, and sophia to map substitution fallbacks to routing policy.

mike: timeline? can we have first-pass numbers by next Wed?

devon: yes, running this week, will have draft by Wed EOD

sophia: will review routing implications and share recommended fallback thresholds

ashley: thanks all. closing loop after Wed. :rocket:
